t: You're at the memorial to Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar, who is both commemorated and depicted here. Ambedkar was an Indian jurist, economist and social reformer. He chaired the committee that drafted the Constitution of India, and he served as Law and Justice minister in the first cabinet of Jawaharlal Nehru. Later he renounced Hinduism and converted to Buddhism, which inspired the Dalit Buddhist movement.
